_comment: Custom search profiles. Load a profile by appending ?profile=<name> to the app URL.

_format.name: URL-safe identifier used in ?profile=<name>
_format.description: Human-readable label shown in the UI
_format.seeds: Name strings — searched on both FINRA BrokerCheck and SEC AdviserInfo
_format.individuals: CRD numbers (integers) — fetched directly from BrokerCheck individual detail
_format.firms: Firm CRD numbers (integers) — fetched directly from BrokerCheck firm detail
_format.enabled: Boolean — when true, load seeds from the local graph file only (no outbound FINRA/SEC API calls)
